# Hours on assignment this week

10 – 12 hours

---

# 1. What I completed this week

- Continued implementation and refinement of the imputation stage (`04_impute.R`) within the pipeline

- Implemented median imputation for remaining missing numeric values in:
  - `quantity`
  - `total_spent`

- Implemented simple category-based hot-deck imputation for missing `item` values using the most frequently occurring item within each category

- Created missingness indicator variables to preserve information for unresolved missing values in `discount_applied`

- Generated post-imputation outputs including:
  - `missing_after_imputation.csv`
  - `missing_imputation_comparison.csv`
  - `final_missingness_summary.csv`

- Implemented final validation checks after imputation to verify:
  - Remaining total spent mismatches
  - Invalid quantity values
  - Invalid price values
  - Invalid total spent values

- Confirmed that no invalid numeric inconsistencies remained after imputation and validation

- Developed the export stage (`05_export.R`) to automatically export finalized datasets into multiple formats, including:
  - CSV
  - Excel (`.xlsx`)
  - SPSS (`.sav`)
  - Stata (`.dta`)
  - RDS (`.rds`)

- Configured the export process to include the generated data dictionary within the Excel workbook

- Developed the automated reporting stage (`06_report.Rmd`) to generate a fully reproducible Word report summarizing:
  - Diagnostics
  - Cleaning procedures
  - Imputation methods
  - Validation checks
  - Final outputs

- Enhanced the automated report by:
  - Improving document structure and sectioning
  - Adding styled tables using `flextable`
  - Adding colored charts and visual summaries
  - Improving readability and formatting for Word output

- Updated `run_pipeline.R` to support:
  - Export generation
  - Automated Word report rendering
  - End-to-end pipeline execution from ingestion through reporting

- Refined and finalized the project `README.md` to improve:
  - Reproducibility instructions
  - Pipeline architecture documentation
  - Project structure explanations
  - Execution guidance
  - Imputation method documentation

- Performed repository cleanup by removing unnecessary intermediate outputs and retaining only final deliverables and important summaries

- Executed the complete pipeline successfully using a single command and verified that all outputs were generated correctly
